content:
Talia Benson: Quick coordination for release train timing on enabling hot-route capacity protection flags across regions. Target is us-east first (canary allowlist) then eu-west next train. Can we confirm go/no-go checklist + who’s on point?

Benji Okafor: Yep. Flags are ready behind allowlist + region gate. Current plan I have:
- Thu 18:00–19:00 PT: us-east canary enable for allowlisted enterprise accounts
- Fri 10:00 PT: expand allowlist if metrics look clean
- Next train: eu-west enable (same process)
Need sign-offs from SRE + Routing + Gateway.

DeployBot: release-train-bot: Next release window: Thu 18:00 PT (commit cut 17:15 PT). Rollback window available until 19:30 PT.

Rafael Mendes: For SRE, fine with Thu 18:00 PT as long as we treat it as a monitored change window (not “silent enable”). I can have on-call + me watching.

Aisha Bello: +1. We should explicitly call out alert expectations so we don’t page-storm on expected best-effort shedding. Also want a crisp rollback criterion.

Amara Diallo: Gateway side is in prod already (tier-aware limiter + reason codes). The enablement is mostly policy + routing admission behavior. But: we need to double-check the 429 headers are consistent across streaming + non-streaming (last patch went in).

Mina Haddad: Routing is ready for us-east. Capacity signals are stable. Biggest risk is threshold tuning (queue depth) if long-prompt traffic spikes.

Irene Choi: Infra note: us-east GPU pools have tighter headroom 18:00–20:00 PT because of scheduled batch jobs. Not blocking, but worth noting. eu-west has more slack.

Vanessa Ortiz: Fleet signals look good today. If you’re gating by scheduler_lag + queue_depth, please use the updated thresholds from last week. The older ones were too sensitive in us-east.

Talia Benson: Great. Can we align on a go/no-go checklist in-thread so the release captain can just tick boxes?

Benji Okafor: Draft checklist (go/no-go):
1) Config migration for route groups applied in us-east (no diffs / errors)
2) Feature flag state:
   - hot_route_protection_enabled=false globally
   - region.us-east=enabled (canary only)
   - allowlist contains: Acme AI + Proxima Bank pilot accounts only
3) Dashboards open + healthy baseline (30m):
   - enterprise p95/p99 latency stable on /v1/chat/completions and embeddings
   - 5xx not elevated
   - shed_rate expected to increase only for best-effort tier
4) Alerting:
   - burn-rate alerts armed for enterprise SLOs
   - best-effort shedding alerts muted/annotated (no paging)
5) Support readiness:
   - macro for “429 reason codes” ready
   - escalation owner on-call (Dev/Owen) aware of window
6) Rollback:
   - single toggle: region.us-east=disabled
   - confirm rollback script tested in staging

Rafael Mendes: Looks good. I’d add:
- Confirm incident-bot posts on protection activation are showing in #incidents (we rely on that as a “did it trigger?” signal)
- Confirm we have an annotation ready for Grafana when we flip the flag (helps with later analysis)

Logan Wright: Telemetry check: please make sure the dashboards are using the new low-cardinality tags (tier + route_group) and NOT tenant_id. We had that regression before. I can spot check 15 min before window.

Aisha Bello: Rollback criteria suggestion:
- If enterprise p99 latency degrades >20% sustained 10m OR enterprise 429_rate >0.5% sustained 5m, rollback.
- If best-effort 429 spikes, that’s expected. Only rollback if we see collateral: enterprise 5xx or routing errors.

Amara Diallo: Also watch 429 reason breakdown:
- quota_exceeded vs overload_shed
If enterprise sees quota_exceeded unexpectedly, that’s a config issue (wrong tier mapping) => rollback + fix.

Dev Patel: Support readiness: we have the updated macro copy. Only ask: please post the exact customer-facing phrasing we should use during the canary (“capacity protection rolling out; retry with backoff; enterprise is prioritized”) and what’s escalatable vs expected.

Talia Benson: I’ll post the comms snippet in #support and link it here before the window.

Mina Haddad: One more gate: validate the allowlist is correct. We had a near-miss last time where an internal load test account was tagged enterprise and got protected unexpectedly.

Benji Okafor: Good call. I’ll run the preflight:
- dump effective policy for allowlisted accounts
- verify route_group mapping: chat, embeddings, rerank
- verify fallback policy guardrails: chat route is “no silent model fallback” for enterprise; should be strict admission control.

Vanessa Ortiz: If you see admission control oscillation (on/off rapidly), ping me. That’s usually a signal smoothing issue; we can tweak the window without fully rolling back.

Rafael Mendes: Who is release captain? I can be the “SRE go/no-go” but want a single driver.

Talia Benson: Benji is release captain for the train; Rafael is SRE sign-off; Mina is routing sign-off; Amara gateway sign-off; Logan telemetry sign-off; Irene infra awareness.

DeployBot: release-train-bot: Reminder set for Thu 17:45 PT: “hot-route protection us-east canary go/no-go”.

Benji Okafor: Plan for the window:
- 17:45 PT: preflight checks + dashboards opened
- 18:00 PT: flip region.us-east=enabled (allowlist only)
- 18:05 PT: confirm incident-bot message + dashboard annotation
- 18:15 PT: evaluate p95/p99 + 429 reasons
- 18:30 PT: decision: keep / rollback
- 18:50 PT: update thread + #eng-sre + #support

Aisha Bello: Please also capture a screenshot of the enterprise SLO burn panel pre/post. Makes the post-launch review easier.

Logan Wright: I’ll be around 17:45–18:30 to verify metrics cardinality and that the new panels populate.

Amara Diallo: I’m good for gateway sign-off. If anything weird shows up for streaming termination semantics, loop me in (we can revert the streaming-specific change independently, but hopefully not needed).

Mina Haddad: Routing sign-off: OK. Only requirement is we do NOT expand allowlist same day unless stability is clean for at least 60 min.

Rafael Mendes: SRE sign-off: OK with the checklist + rollback criteria. Let’s treat this as a “change event” and not a passive config tweak.

Talia Benson: Locked. I’ll send a calendar hold + post the final checklist as a pinned message in this thread.

Benji Okafor: Pinning final checklist now (same as above + Rafael/Logan additions). Everyone please react with :thumbsup: if good.

Rafael Mendes: :thumbsup:

Mina Haddad: :thumbsup:

Amara Diallo: :thumbsup:

Logan Wright: :thumbsup:

Irene Choi: :thumbsup: (noting the us-east headroom caveat)

Dev Patel: :thumbsup: (once I have the comms snippet)

Talia Benson: :thumbsup: I’ll drop comms snippet within the hour.
